instrument.question: Will the Bank of Israel make no change to the Bank of Israel Interest Rate after the October decision?
instrument.description:
This market will resolve according to the change in the Bank of Israel Interest Rate resulting from the Bank of Israel’s October monetary policy decision, relative to the level it was prior to this decision.

The resolution source for this market is information released by the Bank of Israel after its October 21, 2026 monetary policy decision, as listed on the official Bank of Israel interest rate decision schedule: https://www.boi.org.il/en/economic-roles/monetary-policy/interest-rate-announcement-dates-2026/

This market may resolve as soon as the Bank of Israel's announcement of their October 21, 2026 decision with relevant data is issued. If no decision on the Bank of Israel Interest Rate is issued by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.
